description: Repository class for managing OAuth client data using Prisma ORM in a NestJS application.

classes.name: OAuthClientRepository
classes.description: Repository class for CRUD operations and queries related to OAuth clients.

methods.name: createOAuthClient
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client associated with an organization.

methods.name: getOAuthClient
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth client by its ID.

methods.name: getOAuthClientWithAuthTokens
methods.description: Fetches an OAuth client along with its authorization tokens and owner info.

methods.name: getOAuthClientWithRefreshSecret
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth client with a specific refresh token secret.

methods.name: getOrganizationOAuthClients
methods.description: Lists all OAuth clients for a given organization.

methods.name: updateOAuthClient
methods.description: Updates an existing OAuth client with new data.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClient
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth client by its ID.

methods.name: getByUserId
methods.description: Finds an OAuth client associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: getByTeamId
methods.description: Finds an OAuth client associated with a specific team ID.

methods.name: getByOrgId
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth client IDs for a specific organization.

methods.name: getByEventTypeHosts
methods.description: Gets OAuth clients linked to hosts of a specific event type.
